amanda: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the reliability incident. RCA (internal): https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-04-18-backpressure-1pager. Drop Qs and own items here.

ben: Thanks. Request from leadership: short exec summary + list of owners and dates. Who can do the one-pager?

kelsey: I can draft the exec one-pager. Need sanitized impacted tenants and confirmation on timeline. ETA Monday noon.

sree: I will own the routing fallback patch and the canary. Plan: PR today, 10% canary tonight, 2h watch. Revert criteria included in PR.

lia: Ill add a dashboard tile for "retry_loop_rate" and an alert with PagerDuty mapping. Can have dashboards tomorrow AM and alert runbook by Monday.

ben: Product asks whether we need to do customer outreach now or wait until we confirm canary stability. Anyffected pilot customers?

kelsey: Two pilots impacted; I will coordinate customer comms after security approves the sanitized RCA link.

ops-bot: watch scheduled: canary window 1782345720-1782349320 started by sree :eyes:

amanda: Repro snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-04-18T09:42:11Z router: upstream-conn-reset retries=4
2026-04-18T09:42:12Z worker: prefix_hit=false kvcache_miss=true
2026-04-18T09:42:12Z router: aggressive-retry triggered attempt=6
```

sree: Adding a small CI smoke test for prefix-miss + retry pattern. Will PR next after canary patch.

kelsey: Action summary: (A) Patch & canary  sree (PR today); (B) Dashboards & alerting  lia (tomorrow AM); (C) Exec one-pager + customer comms  kelsey (Mon noon after security sign-off); (D) CI smoke test  sree + eng-qa. Will update the all-hands follow-up doc with links.

amanda: Great. Please update the follow-up doc with PR and runbook links when available. Closing once links present.
